items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: So I'll take Mac to life. You know... Da da da da... Da da da da... Like that.

ctx.x: What did you call that music in those days? That was Dixieland. You called it Dixieland then? That was Dixieland.

I think the music today is... They haven't got the real idea of Dixieland. And it's hard for you to get a man to form up a band with Dixieland music. Simple fact, this guy says he knows this and he knows that. And when it comes to flying, he don't know nothing. Yeah. He's got his ideas. What did they call the old time bands? Somebody told me they used to call them ragtime bands quite a bit. Yeah. Did you make any difference between the word like ragtime or Dixieland or jazz? Or when did those different words…
What did you say that fast time is? What do you call that fast time again?
